caption: The drawing depicts a teapot rendered with careful shading in grayscale pencil. The teapot has a tall, cylindrical body, a long, slender spout that extends diagonally to the left, and a curved handle on the right, which is filled in with a darker shade to suggest a different material or color. The teapot has a domed lid with a finial on top. There is detailed decorative engraving in the center of the body featuring a heart-shaped shield, with the script initials "MHC" inside it, flanked on both sides by symmetrical arrangements of floral designs. The main teapot is shown in the center of the drawing, occupying most of the space. In the upper left corner, there is a close-up of the heart-shaped shield with the same initials, and in the lower right corner, there is a smaller schematic outline of the teapot indicating its proportions. The background is a plain, pale paper color, and the entire drawing is framed by a faint, single-lined border. The name "Hester Duany" is written in small script at the bottom left corner.
title: Silver Teapot
